name: Jira
description: Your open Jira issues as a column: ↵ pastes the link, ⇧↵ a Markdown link. Paste an issue key as a link, or make an issue from copied text. Jira Cloud, with your email and an API token.
site.title: Site, such as yourteam.atlassian.net
email.title: Email
apiToken.title: API token
project.title: Project key for new issues
issueType.title: Issue type for new issues
source.title: Jira
link.title: Paste link
link.label: Link
markdown.title: Paste Markdown link
markdown.label: Markdown link
keyLink.title: Paste as Jira link
create.title: Create Jira issue from this

setup: Add your Jira site, email and API token in Settings → Extensions → Jira.
noSite: Add your Jira site, such as yourteam.atlassian.net, in Settings → Extensions → Jira.
noEmail: Add the email you sign in to Jira with in Settings → Extensions → Jira.
noToken: Add a Jira API token in Settings → Extensions → Jira. Make one at id.atlassian.com › Security › API tokens.
badSite: The Jira site must be a Jira Cloud address, such as yourteam.atlassian.net.
badEmail: The email in Settings → Extensions → Jira doesn’t look like an email address.
badCredentials: Jira didn’t accept your email and API token. Check them in Settings → Extensions → Jira.
captcha: Jira wants you to sign in on the web first. Sign in at {site} once, then try again.
captcha.column: Jira wants you to sign in on the web first. Sign in at {site} once; the column tries again within 15 minutes.
forbidden: Your Jira account can’t use {site}. Check the site and email in Settings.
noJira: There is no Jira at {site}. Check the site in Settings → Extensions → Jira.
rateLimited.minute: Jira is limiting requests right now. Try again in a minute.
rateLimited.minutes: Jira is limiting requests right now. Try again in {minutes} minutes.
unavailable: Jira isn’t answering right now (status {status}). Try again later.
unreadable: Jira sent an answer that couldn’t be read.
notARow: This row no longer holds a Jira issue.
issueGone: Jira couldn’t find {key}. It may have moved or been deleted.
notAKey: This isn’t a Jira issue key, such as ENG-42.
empty: There is no text to make an issue from.
noProject: Add the project key for new issues, such as ENG, in Settings → Extensions → Jira.
badProject: The project key in Settings must start with a letter and use only A–Z, 0–9 and _, such as ENG.
projectRefused: Jira has no project {project} you can create issues in. Check the project key in Settings.
issueTypeRefused: Project {project} has no issue type “{issueType}”. Check the issue type in Settings.
fieldsRefused: Jira refused some fields for new issues in {project} ({fields}). Create this one in Jira.
tooLong: The text is too long for a Jira issue. Copy a shorter part, or create this one in Jira.
cannotCreate: Your Jira account can’t create issues in {project}.
createdUnreadable: Jira created the issue, but its answer couldn’t be read. Look for it in Jira.
cut: The text was long, so the issue’s description holds only its first {count} characters.
